items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: And Carney was one of your pupils. One of my pupils. ... Carney was going to the New England Conservatory. He left the New England Conservatory to come to me.

ctx.x: Well see, I worked with Lips Page several times, you know. The first time I worked with Lips Page was down in Clinton with a small combination. The next time I worked with Lips Page is, was - I worked with Lips Page at Small's Paradise, too. Then I worked with Lips Page at the Savoy Ballroom, I worked with Hot Lips Page at Kelly's Stable. See, I worked with Hot Lips Page many, many, many different times. I worked at Small's Paradise with Hot Lips Page also and made arrangements for him.
Hey, we're gettin' a lit bit away from Boston, I think we should try to clear - why don't you tell the story, soup to nuts, of you and Harry Carney in Boston in the early '20's?
